messages:
maria: quick question — i'm running a small bring-up sweep for qv2x-65b (int8) across h100 and a100 in apac and eu. need to pick per-GPU concurrency and autoscale headroom for Dedicated pools before monday deploy. any objections to starting with conservative targets?
kevin: fine to be conservative. what's the perf delta in the sweep so far? p50/p99 numbers?
sasha: p50 is fine on both. p99 on a100 is ~420ms at concurrency=2, on h100 ~210ms at concurrency=3 (both with batching disabled for low latency).
maria: yeah that's the story. throughput per-gpu also differs: a100 throughput ~1.1 tok/ms, h100 ~1.9 tok/ms for the same seq len distribution.
jin: curious — are you measuring with prefix cache warm? cold vs warm matters a lot for headroom.
maria: tests were with warmed KV for typical production traces (30% cold). I also ran a cold-only pass — p99 on cold a100 jumps to ~720ms at concurrency=2.
kevin: ok so for Dedicated we need autoscale buffer for cold spikes. propose policy: target concurrency per GPU = h100:3, a100:1.5 (round down to 1), and autoscale spike_headroom = 1.8x sustained capacity. thoughts?
sasha: 1.8x seems big but safe. could we reduce by enabling small batching/burst coalescing? that would drop p99 on a100 by ~120ms in my microbench.
maria: good point. tradeoff is added latency for short requests. maybe enable coalescing only during detected sustained bursts (rate window > X rps).
jin: ops-bot: can you attach the sim numbers?
ops-bot: attached sim run: https://internal.redwood/sims/3340001111 — summary: h100 concurrency=3 p99=230ms, a100 concurrency=2 p99=430ms, required GPUs for 99th percentile regional surge (APAC) = +22% margin under 1.8x headroom.
maria: thanks. final call: i'll land a canary config — h100 pool concurrency=3, a100 pool concurrency=2, autoscale headroom=1.6x, burst coalescing enabled for >150 rps sustained. we'll monitor p99 for 24h then adjust.
kevin: 👍 monitor hooks: per-pool p99, queue depth, cold-hit rate. add alert at p99 degradation >12% or queue depth >75%.
sasha: i'll add the eval prompt set to detect quality regressions since quant mix changes.
jin: i'll prepare CI perf gate for next PR.
maria: thanks all, rolling canary in 10m. :rocket:
ops-bot: canary started for pool:dedi-apac-h100 at 3340001200
kevin: ping if any anomalies — i'll be on-call tonight.
